tool.help:
**OpenMC Multiphysics Simulation**
Runs neutron transport through a parametric layered spherical geometry using a 14.1 MeV DT fusion neutron source.
**Geometry**
Add one or more layers in order from the centre outward. Each layer has a material and thickness in cm.
**Supported materials**
- Lithium (breeder) — Li-6/Li-7 mix, density 0.534 g/cm³ - Tungsten (first wall) — W, density 19.3 g/cm³ - Steel / SS316 (structural) — Fe/Cr/Ni/Mo/Mn/Si mix, density 7.99 g/cm³ - Beryllium (multiplier) — Be, density 1.85 g/cm³
**Simulation Settings**
- Li-6 enrichment fraction (natural = 0.076, fully enriched = 1.0) - Batches and particles control statistical accuracy - Mesh resolution sets the NxNxN grid for heating and DPA tallies
**Outputs**
- TBR report — human readable summary of geometry and results - TBR tabular — TBR mean and std dev for use in Galaxy workflows - Heating mesh — volumetric heat deposition (eV/source particle) on 3D mesh - DPA mesh — damage energy (eV/source particle) on 3D mesh
